grammar.summary: 本课学习 prefer 的三种句式与 disguise 场景。

points.title: prefer A to B / prefer to do
points.explanation: prefer + 名词 + to + 名词（prefer golf to tennis）；prefer to do rather than do（宁愿做A不做B）。

examples.en: They prefer to travel without being recognized.
examples.cn: 他们更喜欢不被认出地旅行。

points.title: 动名词被动 being done
points.explanation: without being recognized = 不被认出，动名词的被动式：being + 过去分词。

examples.en: They wore dark glasses to avoid being recognized.
examples.cn: 他们戴墨镜以免被认出。
